title: Range Sum Query Immutable
statement: Given an array of integers nums and a list of queries where each query is [left, right] (0-indexed, inclusive), return a list containing, for each query, the sum of nums[left..right]. Return the results in the same order as the input queries.
hints: Answering each query by summing a slice directly is O(n) per query; with many queries that's slow.
Precompute a prefix-sum array once so that any range sum can be answered in O(1) using prefix[right+1] - prefix[left].
Build prefix where prefix[0] = 0 and prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + nums[i]. For each query [l, r], the answer is prefix[r+1] - prefix[l].
